topology.instructions: This `flow` is one decision pipeline (already decomposed). Which call structure fits it?

criteria.T1_fanout: Several independent questions over the same state in one call
criteria.T2_chain: A later call's questions/state depend on an earlier call's answer
criteria.T3_loop: Same call repeated with fresh state each tick/step
criteria.T4_map: Same call mapped over many independent records/candidates
criteria.T5_beam: Expand only top-k branches into deeper calls
criteria.T6_tournament: Items adjudicated against each other or a stored set
criteria.T7_diamond: Independent sub-judgments combined into one composite

needs_sequential.instructions: This flow needs sequential calls: a later judgment depends on an earlier judgment's typed answer.

needs_parallel_map.instructions: This flow maps the same judgment over many independent items.

needs_loop.instructions: This flow repeats the same judgment over fresh state each step.

needs_exit_option.instructions: The choice set for this flow is incomplete; it needs a none/other/review/abstain option.

needs_verify_leg.instructions: A high-stakes or easy-to-get-wrong pick in this flow needs a second verify/refine call before acting.

collapse_chain_to_fanout.instructions: A sequential chain in this flow would blow an interactive latency budget and should be collapsed: ask the first question plus all branch questions in one call and read the relevant leg.
